observations.code_quote: In cloud, dispatch stamps each run as telemetry-enabled in run state, and the scout run-log mirror only mirrors stamped runs. `DEBUG` skips the stamp, so locally these settings are the only switch. They're injected into the sandbox as `POSTHOG_AGENT_OTEL_LOGS_URL`/`_TOKEN`/`POSTHOG_AGENT_OTEL_TRACES_URL` (deliberately not standard `OTEL_*` names, so OTel SDKs in user code don't auto-export into the telemetry project).
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies telemetry opt-in and its relationship to the `DEBUG` bypass and the `tasks-agent-run-otel-telemetry` flag, but no score assigned.
